title: Deye unveils 2.56 kWh hybrid battery for balcony, residential PV
content: The Chinese manufacturer said the system is designed for easy AC-coupled integration with existing PV systems and scalable expansion up to 7.5 kW three-phase output. The system purportedly delivers 800 W–2.5 kW AC output, supports up to 5.76 kW PV input with 96.5% efficiency.

title: SAJ unveils its ecosystem strategy and three new products at the elekeeper ecosystem partner conference
content: At its 2026 SAJ elekeeper Ecosystem Partner Conference, SAJ showcased new products for the residential and C&I market segments. The manufacturer is marking its shift away from traditional passive solar energy toward an era of proactive AI.

title: Singapore team builds 19.7%-efficient ultrathin ‘biPoly’ TOPCon solar cell
content: The ultra-thin TOPCon solar cell uses dual-sided polysilicon passivated contacts formed by low-pressure chemical vapor deposition. The champion device, with a thickness of only 80 μm, achieved 19.7% efficiency with 719 mV open-circuit voltage and demonstrated strong passivation, optical performance, and mechanical flexibility.

title: Record-dry April lifts irradiance across Eastern Australia
content: In a new weekly update for pv magazine, Solcast, a DNV company, reports that April 2026 was one of Australia’s driest Aprils in recent years, with widespread rainfall deficits driven by persistent high pressure and ENSO returning to neutral, leading to mostly clear skies and above-normal solar irradiance across much of the continent. title: Chinese wafer producers build inventory ahead of expected Q3 demand recovery

title: Brazil increases import tax on batteries at local manufacturer’s request
content: The measure raises the import tariff from 18% to 25% for 48V LFP batteries intended for stationary applications in telecommunications and photovoltaic systems of up to 4.8 kW until May 2027, following a request from the domestic industry via LETEC. For other batteries classified as lithium-ion electric accumulators, the reduced rate of 18% remains.

title: Mexico launches call for renewable energy, storage projects linked to state utility CFE
content: The scheme targets projects of 0.7 MW and above, with a 935 MW indicative storage need, and is part of broader reforms to streamline investment while strengthening state-led planning of the electricity sector.

title: Colombia regulates transmission capacity allocation to speed up energy project connections
content: The measure aims to reduce grid connection delays and ease congestion in the National Interconnected System (SIN) amid rising electricity demand.

title: India has now 32.9 GW of operational PV capacity under private PPAs
content: Mercom reports that the so-called "open-access" solar installations were up 170% year-over-year from 1 GW added in Q1 2025. As of March 2026, cumulative installed solar open access capacity stood at 32.9 GW.

title: Australia opens tenders for 2.5 GW of solar and wind alongside 12.5 GWh of storage
content: Australia's New South Wales is rolling out two of the biggest renewable energy tenders in the state’s history, seeking 2.5 GW of new generation capacity in addition to 12.5 GWh of long-duration energy storage.

title: Masdar picks Sungrow as supplier for world’s largest 24/7 renewable energy project in UAE
content: Masdar has selected Sungrow for the world’s first gigawatt-scale 24/7 dispatchable renewable energy project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
